title.line: N redesigns of your site, side by side. Keep one.

scenes.text: This landing page works. It just looks like every other template. Variantly redesigns your site several ways at once, and you keep the one you like.
Run npx variantly in your project. It opens a wizard in your browser, and uses the coding agent you already have. Here, Claude Code.
Setup checks the app, the agent, and the Impeccable design skill.
Choose how many designs to make: two, four or six. We'll take four.
Say who the site is for, what it offers, and what must stay. Here: the prices, the sign-up button and the FAQ.

actions.text: Small agencies and studios who bill clients by the hour.
Timers, weekly timesheets, approvals and invoices from tracked hours.
The name, the three plans and their prices, the sign-up button, the FAQ.

scenes.text: Review the brief, and make the designs. Nothing in your project changes yet.
Each design gets its own git worktree and its own dev server. Your agent works headless, two at a time, checks its work in a real browser, and every result is scored with axe-core and Lighthouse.
Then compare, on your real site. Drag the divider for a before and after.
Every direction was designed from scratch for this site. Switch between them in one click.
Accessibility, performance, best practices and SEO, each measured against the original.
Keep the one you like. It's applied to your working tree with a three-way merge. The others stay as branches.
Variantly. It runs on your machine, with your own agent. Try it with npx variantly.
